description:
Design a NEMA 17 stepper motor mounting plate using the Part Design workbench. 

1. Create a new document and a Body.
2. Create a square base plate: 50mm x 50mm, 6mm thick, centered at the origin.
3. Create a central pilot hole: 22mm diameter (through all).
4. Create 4 mounting holes using the 'Hole' tool (do NOT use Pocket for these). 
   - Spacing: 31mm center-to-center (centered at origin).
   - Profile: Metric M3, Countersunk 90 degrees.
5. Apply 5mm fillets to the four outer corners of the plate.
6. Save the file to '/home/ga/Documents/FreeCAD/nema_plate.FCStd'.
